'''Jilan Noor''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Lieutenant Commander/Legends|Lieutenant Commander]] for the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. He commanded [[Freighter M226]] as part of the secret convoy known as [[Perlemian Haul]].<ref name="PH" />
